positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
1. Leveraged Chef, Amazon Web Services and Go Continuous Delivery to automate the complete creation of Elastic Beanstalk cloud formation stacks for a file server, an Audit and Control Management server, and a web application server
2. Initiated and contributed eleven custom resources to a shared Chef cookbook which is used by every cookbook in GCM, making recipes more concise and promoting adherence to the DRY principle
3. Independently and proactively built an interactive python data visualization tool for Chef logs in order to identify the bottlenecks in a given log

positions.title: Scenario Analysis Development Intern
positions.description:
1. Overhauled Scenario Analysis's Crystal Reports with out of the box solutions providing clearer, more detailed, and more readable reports thereby increasing the value of the reports. 
2. Implemented a dynamic scaling utility class and algorithm in order to make large accounts based in foreign currencies such as the yen readable by preventing numbers from overlapping 
3. Produced work around to allow super script in Crystal Reports where it is not natively supported

positions.title: Business Intelligence Development Intern
positions.description:
1. Planned, developed and delivered Java tool to parse hospital and clinical CSV files to find cross-database patient matches
2. Reduced 395,784 patient entries in the hospital file and 127,629  patient entries in the clinical file  to 132,804 and  127,154 unique entries respectively 
3.  Successfully matched 64,769 patients making the match percentage 48.48​% in under 20 seconds despite heterogeneous and poor data quality conditions
4. Improved internal consistency and aided in more accurate reporting

projects.title: Collaborative Spotify Controller
projects.description:
1. Extended Spotify’s example application to allow the user to control Spotify from their browser
2. Currently developing a shared music controller for multiple people to connect to one Spotify account and manage the queue together

projects.title: Sudoku Solver
projects.description:
1. Created an interactive Java Swing Sudoku application that supports Sudoku’s of arbitrary size
2. Built five different Sudoku solving AIs with the best solver being able to solve 25 by 25 Sudoku puzzles
3. Implemented a Sudoku generating algorithm that successfully generates a random valid Sudoku puzzle with a given number of empty spaces
4. Leveraged a MySql database to store and load puzzles of known difficulty as generated by “qqwing” a commercial Sudoku generating application
